_doc: Shared search fixture (PRD-027 FR3). Consumed by tests/test_search.py (agentcad.core.search) and, from slice 5, by the node test of frontend/js/query_model.js: the two parsers/matchers must agree row for row and rank for rank, and this file is the only place that agreement is written down. `parts` is in manifest order — every `expect` list is in RANK order, and ties fall back to that manifest order. A case with `needs_script: true` depends on script text, which the browser does not have; the client port answers those by calling the server instead. A case with `error: true` must be refused by `parse` with a validation_error. Cases whose note starts with `ranking:` return rows at DIFFERENT ranks and are the ones that pin the rank table: they are written so that manifest order and rank order disagree, and a port that ranks by anything else gets them wrong.

        Box(60, 40, p.t)
    return part.part

cases.note: free text, two rows in manifest order
negated tag: everything else, manifest order
material is exact, never a prefix
script carries a package provenance header
segment-wise: A/bc is NOT under a/b
empty query matches everything, manifest order
ranking: material (2) beats script (4), against manifest order
ranking: id/label (0) beat tag (1) beat material (2) — three ranks in one query, and manifest order disagrees at every step
field term + script-only text hit: still a script-only match
a folder value of nothing but separators
